Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready transparent 2x2 sprite sheet for an animated chat sticker, designed for exact equal-quadrant machine cropping.
Create one completely original mascot consistently across four action poses: a round cream-white glutinous-rice-dumpling creature, oversized soft bun-shaped head, a distinctive cluster of glossy orange mochi knots as a topknot, two floppy cream ear-like side tufts tipped warm orange, tiny rounded arms and feet with orange tips, warm orange scarf tied in a large bow behind the right shoulder, amber eyes, tiny mouth, peach blush, thin warm-orange outline, luminous coral heart held in both hands. Premium soft gouache sticker rendering, gentle cream/tangerine palette. Same exact character identity, proportions, costume, materials, view and lighting in all four.
Arrange four true bowing key poses in an invisible equal 2x2 layout, reading:
TOP-LEFT: upright neutral preparation, heart at chest, open attentive eyes.
TOP-RIGHT: beginning to bow, waist/head/shoulders lowered about 25 degrees, heart follows naturally.
BOTTOM-LEFT: deepest bow, torso strongly compressed and nearly horizontal, eyes closed, heart low, feet planted.
BOTTOM-RIGHT: rises upright and extends heart forward with biggest grateful closed-eye smile and a small sparkle burst.
Real anatomy/posture/face changes, not shifted/scaled duplicates. Each complete pose centered within its own quadrant, large transparent gutters at both center axes, no overlap/crossing.
CRITICAL OUTPUT: genuine transparent PNG alpha outside artwork. Do NOT draw or visualize a checkerboard, white/gray field, backdrop, floor, panel, shadow plane, divider, cell outline, frame or border.
NO text, letters, numbers, labels, signs, writing-like marks, watermark, logo, brand, existing IP, crops, extra limbs or malformed hands.
安全约束：完全原创，原创，无文字，无水印，无品牌，无现有角色。
透明2x2动作表：同一只原创蜂蜜金与奶油白幼犬叼白色雏菊，依次端坐、抬爪、挥爪、开心挥爪；写实柔软毛发、全身完整、宽透明格间距、主体四边安全留白，不含文字、商标、名犬或网络梗犬。安全约束：完全原创，原创，无文字，无水印，无品牌，无现有角色。

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: production transparent 2x2 sprite sheet for exact equal-quadrant cropping.
Create the same completely original fictional young adult office worker consistently in all four: distinctive wavy dark-brown hair, expressive warm face not based on a real person, coral rolled-sleeve shirt, loose navy tie, navy trousers, brown belt/shoes, premium contemporary editorial 2D illustration with subtle paper grain and bold clean shapes. Same identity, outfit, proportions, lighting, camera and palette in every pose. One ordinary completely BLANK white paper is the tiny favor being thanked for.
Four true over-the-top gratitude/bow stages in invisible 2x2 order:
TOP-LEFT standing calmly, naturally holding the blank paper with both hands at waist, mild polite smile.
TOP-RIGHT surprised delight, beginning to bend knees and bow while keeping the paper securely in both hands against the torso.
BOTTOM-LEFT physically lowered onto both knees, torso bowing deeply; paper held securely flat against chest, never floating.
BOTTOM-RIGHT maximum absurd gratitude, upright on both knees with palms pressed together and beaming upward; the blank paper lies flat on the ground immediately beside one knee with correct contact and perspective.
Real full-body anatomy changes, not shifted copies. One complete worker per quadrant, paper position physically plausible, generous transparent gutters, no overlap.
CRITICAL: genuine transparent PNG alpha outside artwork. No checkerboard, backdrop, office room, floor plane, panels, dividers, frames, borders or shadows that join cells. NO text, letters, numbers, marks on paper, labels, signs, watermark, logo, brand, celebrity/IP, crop, extra limbs, malformed hands.
安全约束：完全原创，原创，无文字，无水印，无品牌，无现有角色。

Same completely original small 3D caramel plush bear in all four: cream muzzle/inner ears, glossy dark-brown eyes, fine tactile fur, golden-orange satin bow tie, embroidered dark paw pads, one plain glass of orange juice. In each quadrant position the compact full bear toward local lower-right and leave local center-left transparent for later text. Real limb/torso/face/glass changes, no shifted copies, no overlap/crossing axes.
STRICT TRANSPARENCY: actual alpha-zero clear pixels outside each bear. Absolutely NO black, orange or colored glow field, NO backdrop, vignette, halo, floor, shadow plane, checkerboard, panels, dividers, frames, border. Use clean edge lighting on fur only.
NO text/letters/numbers/labels/signs/watermark/logo/brand/IP, crop, extra limbs, malformed paws, floating glass.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exact-crop transparent 2x2 kinetic sticker pose sheet
Create ONE exact SQUARE RGBA canvas with four separate SMALL, THIN, OPEN CIRCULAR WREATHS centered in four equal invisible quadrants. Preserve a wide transparent plus-shaped gutter between quadrants and an outer transparent border.
Each wreath uses the same original six chunky motifs only: one coral splash, one golden starburst, one cyan droplet, one violet spring and two small yellow smiling-face circles, joined loosely around a circular path with crisp navy outlines.
MOST IMPORTANT: the empty transparent circular HOLE inside EVERY wreath must be HUGE: at least 330 pixels in diameter on a 627-pixel quadrant. The decorative ring must be THIN, no more than 90 pixels thick. The full outer wreath diameter must remain below 500 pixels. Thus both a huge clean text center and at least 60 pixels of transparent outer margin are visible on all four sides. No motif touches any canvas edge or quadrant midpoint.
Animation sequence top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right: compressed ring; slightly stretched spring and splash; peak outward deformation while preserving the huge hole; relaxed recoil. Same motifs and style, true structural motion.
True transparent alpha background, no drawn panels or dividers. Premium polished bold 2D motion graphics, simple and legible.
